title: Beatrix and the Cellar
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Ansel Nakamura, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
